meta.title: Snowflake Premier Partner: Snowflake and Viewnear
meta.description: Viewnear is a Snowflake Premier Partner and CoCo Preferred Partner: governed data foundations, migrations, and the AI layer on Snowflake, from Cortex AI to Cortex AI Gateway, delivered nearshore across the Americas.

hero.kicker: Premier Partner in the Snowflake Partner Network
hero.title: Governed data. The agentic control plane. <hl>One team that ships on Snowflake.</hl>
hero.description: Viewnear is a Snowflake Premier Partner and CoCo Preferred Partner, one of the specialist teams that takes an enterprise from a legacy warehouse to governed data on Snowflake and on to the AI layer above it: Cortex AI, Cortex Agents and Cortex AI Gateway. SnowPro-certified architects and engineers, working US hours from Austin and Monterrey, priced to the result.

ways.eyebrow: Two ways we put Snowflake to work
ways.title: The data foundation, and the AI that runs where the data already is

items.title: Stand up the governed data foundation
items.body: Off Teradata, Oracle or Hadoop and onto one governed copy of the data: Openflow ingestion from the ERP, CRM and SaaS systems already in place, dbt and Snowpark modeling next to the data, Horizon Catalog lineage and access from the first table, Apache Iceberg so the foundation stays open. Live in 8 to 16 weeks, with working software at every sprint demo.

items.title: Run AI where the data already is
items.body: Cortex AISQL and Cortex Analyst over governed Semantic Views, Cortex Agents that plan across structured data and documents, Snowflake CoWork for the people who ask the questions, and Cortex AI Gateway governing which agents reach which data, models and tools. Claude is callable inside it as a Cortex model, so the reasoning happens next to the data and nothing is copied out.

around.title: Snowflake runs the platform. <hl>Viewnear engineers the practice around it.</hl>
around.intro: The recognition is the credential. This is what it changes for a client.

items.title: One plan with the Snowflake team
items.body: We work alongside the client's Snowflake account team on architecture, funding and delivery: aligned incentives and one plan, not a vendor bolted on after the fact.

items.title: Snowflake procurement, simplified
items.body: Snowflake charges for the compute and storage actually consumed. Procuring that capacity through Viewnear means simpler commercial terms, with capacity and delivery under one accountable partner.

items.title: Building with Snowflake CoCo
items.body: As a CoCo Preferred Partner we build data products and AI use cases with Snowflake's coding agent, reviewed object by object and validated before anything reaches production.

items.title: SnowPro-certified delivery
items.body: Certified architects and engineers on every engagement, from the first design session to production, with Snowflake's product teams a call away when a build hits a hard question.

items.title: Documented, then kept improving
items.body: Documentation and runbooks ship with every build. From there the team runs it, or Viewnear keeps running, tuning and improving the Snowflake estate as a managed service.
